title: hr_leave — absence/leave management deep L3
key_findings: Module is named hr_holidays internally (not hr_leave); user-facing name is Time Off
Leave request state machine has NO draft state — records created directly in confirm state
Dual-approval path uses intermediate validate1 state with first_approver_id tracking
Auto-approval triggered at record creation when validation_type == no_validation
No payroll/accounting integration in Community — only work entry bridge via hr_work_entry_holidays (auto-install)
hr_work_entry_holidays replaces attendance work entries with leave work entries on approval and restores them on refusal
Two daily cron jobs: one for accrual computation, one for cancelling leaves that exceed accrual balance
Three security groups: Time Off Responsible, Officer (manage all), Administrator
Officers cannot self-approve leaves; only Administrator role can approve own requests
Leave type has negative balance cap feature (allows_negative + max_allowed_negative)
